title: Taper Turning on a stepped bar reports rest outside its window

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
Found during #2865. Related catalog work: #2392.

Base: upstream/main `58cb641ca`.

Use original closed meshes. Revolve each listed `(radius, Z)` meridian about Z with 48 angular segments.
Use `assets/machines/lathe.mch` and the `Fanuc Lathe` post.
Import the blank as stock with `set_stock {from_model: ...}`.
Set `set_raw_stock_only {on: true}`. Keep all verification checks active.

## What happens

Taper Turning finishes the upper 20 mm of a stepped bar.
The blank already has this taper, so the radial retract has clearance.
Generation succeeds. Verification blocks the post:

```text
finish envelope near move 7: 0.0000 mm gouge, 38.9500 mm rest
```

## Reproduce

The finished meridian is:

```text
(0,0), (8,0), (10,2), (10,12), (9,12), (9,40), (8,60), (0,60)
```

The blank meridian is:

```text
(0,0), (10,0), (10,12), (9,12), (9,40), (8,60), (0,60)
```

Create Chamfering with `TN-1600-0R8` first.
Its fixed heights are clearance 70, top 2 and bottom 0.
Use angle 45 degrees, tolerance 0.05, feed 120 and plunge feed 40.

Create Taper Turning next, with the same tool and finished source.
Use fixed heights: clearance 70, top 60, bottom 40.
Use bottom diameter 18, top diameter 16 and tolerance 0.05.
Use feed 120 and plunge feed 40.
Generate, then call `verify`.

The stated taper matches the source model throughout Z40..60.
The earlier chamfer has its own refusal. That refusal is a separate report.
The taper also has the quoted independent warning.

## Expected result

Judge the taper in Z40..60. Features below this window must not create 38.95 mm of rest for this operation.

## Passing comparison

A simple cone verifies and posts with a full-length Taper Turning window.
Its meridian is `(0,0),(10,0),(8,60),(0,60)`.
Use the same cone as stock.
Use bottom 0, top 60, bottom diameter 20 and top diameter 16.
Keep the same tool, tolerance 0.05 and 48 angular segments.

The evidence does not isolate the completion check that assigns the rest.
Related issue #2880 concerns Profile Finish, not Taper Turning.

Effort: high. The fix changes a verification rule and has the safety floor.

Done means: A test reproduces this refusal. The valid operation verifies and posts. Real gouges and unfinished promised surfaces still block posting.
